messages:
maria (PM): ok team — planning a 6–8 partner design cohort for the private preview. want to lock recruitment priorities and success gates today.
joel (SE): timeline? are we aiming for a soft launch in june or july?
sam (Growth): june is tight but doable if we start outreach this week. we should prioritize partners with existing infra needs (llm inference) + high token volume.
ben (Platform): agree on infra-heavy customers. also want to capture a mix of: 1) multi-tenant SaaS, 2) regulated (finance/health), 3) internal platform teams. that will exercise Dedicated and Private flows.
jessica (Ops): what's the expected commit from partners? time per week? data access?
maria (PM): ideal: 4–6 engineers, 1 product owner, 2–4hrs/week for 8 weeks. access to a small prompt corpus and perf traces (anonymized) for evals.
eva (Legal): we'll need NDA + data processing addendum for any logs. prefer using our standard pilot MSA + short rider. i can prep checklist.
joel (SE): recruitment rubric suggestion: fit score (0–10) = production-readiness (0–4) + volume (0–2) + privacy/reg (0–2) + integration effort (0–2). accept 7+ for top cohort.
sam (Growth): incentive idea: 6 months free Dedicated credits + co-marketing + early roadmap input. small stipend for research time?
jessica (Ops): stipend would increase uptake for smaller startups. budget ok?
maria (PM): budget approved for up to 6 stipends. keep credits as primary incentive; stipend only if engagement risk high.
ben (Platform): gating criteria for launch readiness from partner perspective: 1) model pinned and validated on 1k sample prompts, 2) <100ms P95 degradation after kv-cache enabled, 3) rollout policy tested in canary for 48h.
joel (SE): add quality gate: no >5% regression on hallucination metric on partner prompts vs baseline.
eva (Legal): please flag any PHI or regulated data in advance. we cannot accept raw PHI into hosted logs without extra controls.
sam (Growth): outreach playbook: 1) identify target list (15), 2) 1st touch + product one-pager, 3) screening call, 4) technical intake. goal: convert 6/15.
maria (PM): who owns the screening call?
joel (SE): SEs for technical intake, product for screening. I'll take first 5 screens next week.
jessica (Ops): ops will own onboarding checklist + provisioning flow (private creds, roles, whitelists).
ben (Platform): instrumenting telemetry: we need token-level cost, latency histograms, failure traces, and prompt set diffs. share a sample dashboard template in #eng-platform.
maria (PM): cadence for feedback: weekly short surveys + biweekly 1:1 product interviews + end-of-cohort eval. cadence doc: https://go.internal/redwood/pilot-cadence (draft).
sam (Growth): define success metrics: partner NPS > 7, integration time < 4 weeks, per-token cost reduction recommendation -> >=10% post-optimization, and 3 repeat customers or case studies.
ojo (random-typo): lol
joel (SE): (ignoring typo) also measure adoption signal: % of requests routed to Redwood vs fallback endpoints.
eva (Legal): turnaround on pilot rider: 48–72h once partner accepts. flag any vendor OA requirements.
deploy-bot: Reminder: security review required before granting access to private preview environment. See checklist: /security/review.
maria (PM): action items: sam — build target list & outreach copy by Tue; joel — run screens w/ me Th/F; ben — dashboard template by Wed; jessica — onboarding playbook by Wed; eva — pilot rider draft by Tue. I'll coordinate kickoff invites.
sam (Growth): noted, will post candidate list + outreach copy to this thread.
joel (SE): will block calendar for screens.
maria (PM): thanks all. small ask — keep replies terse in thread so we can export for handoff. :heart:
